## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm -r test` pass.
- [ ] If I changed how two parts talk to each other (schemas, Convex functions, momctl commands, config keys, files on disk), I updated `docs/contracts.md` in this pull request. Otherwise, `docs/contracts.md` didn't need to change.
- [ ] If the change shows on the laptop's screen, I tested it in `dev/session.sh` or on a laptop, and attached a screenshot.
- [ ] Nothing personal is in the diff, the screenshots or the commit messages: no real names, phone numbers, Telegram usernames, hostnames, Tailscale addresses, tokens or family photos.
